coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: Picture pages: cells, squares and rules found as ink in each embedded picture at its own resolution (inklist.py), thin boxes snapped to their printed edges (snap.py), converted through the drawing matrix; every picture looked at; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: Oxford Park Income Fund investor application printed from a browser: six form pages, each one picture (1700x2200 px) on its own PDF page, plus a W-9. The investor and joint investor sign form page 4; the fund accepts beside it (firm); the custodian signs and guarantees on page 3; the broker-dealer/RIA completes and signs page 5.
signing.note: Pictures drawn at x 32.17-584.25, y 36.58-750.98 with a page clip at y 735.75; nothing printed falls below the clip except footers.
